_comment: AI providers, managed from the AI page. One entry per service or relay; Dev Setup reads these when pointing a device's AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) at an endpoint. A provider holds no key of its own: secret_id references a token sealed in the credential vault, minted on the Credentials page.
_comment_fields: Each entry: id (panel-assigned uuid), name, kind (anthropic | openai | gemini | custom), base_url (empty means the service's default; set it for relays), secret_id (a vault token id, or null for a provider stored without a key), is_enabled, models, created_at. The list ships empty; the panel fills it.
